items.title: A new Solana proposal aims to ramp up daily SOL Burns from $47,000 to $650,000
items.whyYouShouldCare: Increasing daily SOL burns could significantly reduce supply, potentially enhancing SOL's value and attractiveness within the ecosystem.

items.title: Base Passes Solana in Curated Capital Milestone (Flash News)
